title: RAG Mastery
description: Fixed operator-curated pathway from Tracker's RAG Mastery plan. No per-student curriculum generation.

learning_flow: Watch an associated video when present

topics.title: Naive/Standard RAG — the baseline pipeline (chunk→embed→retrieve→generate)
topics.description: Naive/Standard RAG — the baseline pipeline (chunk→embed→retrieve→generate)
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: Naive / Standard RAG (foundations)
resources.content: The original Retrieval-Augmented Generation paper (Lewis et al.) + the baseline RAG pipeline: chunk, embed, store, retrieve top-k, stuff into prompt, generate. The naive baseline everything else improves on.

topics.title: Hybrid RAG — BM25 + dense + Reciprocal Rank Fusion
topics.description: Hybrid RAG — BM25 + dense + Reciprocal Rank Fusion
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: Hybrid RAG — BM25 + Dense + RRF
resources.content: Combine lexical (BM25/sparse) and semantic (dense) retrieval, fuse with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Why hybrid beats either alone; weighting and fusion tradeoffs. Matches DocCluster's BM25+cosine.

topics.title: Graph RAG — knowledge-graph retrieval (GraphRAG); compare LightRAG/PageIndex
topics.description: Graph RAG — knowledge-graph retrieval (GraphRAG); compare LightRAG/PageIndex
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: Graph RAG — Knowledge-Graph Retrieval
resources.content: Microsoft GraphRAG: build an entity/relationship knowledge graph from documents, community-summarize, retrieve over the graph for global/multi-hop questions. Compare to LightRAG (L68) and PageIndex (L8).

topics.title: Read README, study knowledge graph + dual-level retrieval (global/local); compare vs GraphRAG (L105); integrate as DocCluster alternative backend
topics.description: Read README, study knowledge graph + dual-level retrieval (global/local); compare vs GraphRAG (L105); integrate as DocCluster alternative backend
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: LightRAG: Simple and Fast Retrieval-Augmented Generation
resources.content: Open-source RAG system combining knowledge graphs with dual-level retrieval for improved query comprehensiveness, diversity, and empowerment. EMNLP 2025. 67.6% vs 32.4% for NaiveRAG on agriculture domain.

topics.title: Chunking strategies — recursive/semantic/sentence-window/parent-document

resources.title: Chunking Strategies
resources.content: Fixed/recursive/semantic/sentence-window/parent-document chunking, overlap, metadata, and how chunking drives retrieval quality. The highest-leverage RAG knob.

resources.content: Embedding models (MTEB, dims, normalization), ANN indexes (HNSW/IVF/PQ), and vector DBs (FAISS, Chroma, pgvector, Pinecone). What to pick and why for a RAG stack.

resources.content: Hands-on FAISS tutorial — efficient similarity search, IndexFlatL2, IndexIVFFlat, IndexIVFPQ. Practical guide to building and querying FAISS indexes for RAG vector retrieval.

resources.content: Recursively clusters + summarizes chunks into a hierarchical tree, retrieves across abstraction levels. Stanford, ICLR 2024. Better multi-hop + long-context RAG.
